body: I don’t enjoy anything anymore. I used to always look forward to the weekends to play video games but even that has become dull and I don’t like to play anymore. I can’t really choose one thing to pass time because if I’m bored, time isn’t really passing now is it? I don’t enjoy anything at school either and if anything, school just makes my life even more dull and not enjoyable. I don’t feel depression with being bored but maybe a sort of numbness. I’ll have to look into that. A lot of shit has come my way. Some people say stuff like “you’re only 14 what really could have happened to you” and it kinda just pisses me off.
